verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the SOC 2 Launchpad guide, which says users generate a blueprint and "action policies". That shows the platform handles policies in some form, but it describes none of the specific capabilities the story asks for. Missing for 10: a lawyer-grade policy template library, an in-platform policy editor, policy versioning, approval workflows, per-employee policy acceptance tracking, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
